gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-sawarabi-mincho: Happy Monkey draws glass-tube letters, hollow and ruler-straight, and they earn their keep big and short. And Sawarabi Mincho, a classic serif, trims its terminals well short of the bowl and eases only slightly where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-sedan: Sedan has a bookish, mellow stroke, with curves a little heavier than joins and terminals held far from the letter body. Happy Monkey has no thick-and-thin at all, so it earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-shippori-mincho: Bold, tube-straight bowls from Happy Monkey never thin at the sides, which makes a lively contrast with the lightly pressed brush shift beneath. And Shippori Mincho, a classic serif, keeps its modest contrast and generous curve openings for a literary hush.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-shippori-mincho-b: Happy Monkey's wide-gapped e and ruler-straight lines never pinch or swell, a stubborn sameness that gives it character. Shippori Mincho B1 is a text serif with middling contrast, so size it up modestly.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-spectral: Spectral is a bookish text serif whose stems run a touch heavier than its crossbars, and its terminals stop short of curling back. Happy Monkey does bold, uniform-gauge shouting; Spectral does the quiet, related thick-and-thin work.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-spectral-sc: Sturdy hairlines and moderate stems give this literary serif a modest thick-and-thin rhythm across every word, with wide mouths on its rounds. Spectral SC handles that fine detail, while Happy Monkey brings bold, pressure-free strokes that never slow the eye.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-stix-two-text: Loud, tubular and unbothered, Happy Monkey keeps every stroke the same as you read, with wide gaps in the e. STIX Two Text, a classic serif, adds a medium weight change along each stroke.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-tai-heritage-pro: Dignified Tai Heritage Pro opens a clear channel into each round letter, its thick strokes only slightly heavier than thin ones. But Happy Monkey outlines its letters with one steady thickness, so a longer read moves from bold hollow tubes into that calm classic serif rhythm.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-taviraj: Bookish and a little tame, Taviraj has medium contrast and a generous gap where each curve ends, never razor thin. Happy Monkey's single-pen-tip boldness against that serif is the pair's sharpest quality.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-trirong: Trirong is a text serif with softly varied strokes and gently flared curve ends that stay apart, so give it a comfortable size. But Happy Monkey stays tube-like and constant in width, with none of that gradual weight change.
